The '''Trickster''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Walkhar]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Walkhar Trickster first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Halloween event as a mount. It could be bought from the Cartel Market.
